# Input

Design a provider-neutral evaluation plan for a confirmed AI-enabled product
behavior. The plan must define a versioned golden set, representative and
adversarial slices, deterministic/human/model-assisted graders, precommitted
quality and safety thresholds, non-regression rules, latency and cost budgets,
and a release verdict based on comparable baseline and candidate runs.

The evaluation must not hide a critical slice behind an aggregate score or
claim readiness from missing, unauthorized, or uncalibrated evidence.
